notes.title: An Update to Change Everything

tags.bug: - Bug with the phone (the handset went up constantly);
- Bug with the already broken bottle in the scene with the father;
- Bug with one of the choices in the game that did not affect anything;
- Now you can’t close yourself on the balcony forever (sorry, introverts);
- You can’t fall from the balcony, as well as close the already closed door;
- Now it is impossible to get stuck in anything;
- Poisonous-green logs in the forest location have acquired a normal color;
- We changed the names of the game in the in-game files;
- A small epic on the menu;
- Bug with the capture of the mouse - now you can make a choice without flying the mouse over the screen;
- Bug with heartbeats after a fight with a wolf in the elevator;
- Bug in the scenes after sleep, in the apartment: now you can’t open the main door;
- Bug with a bed: now you can’t lie down on it and restart the level with the house;
- Bug in the scene with the boss: we removed the second John;
- Loading after the neutral ending in the menu begins on time.

tags.feature: - We changed the type of the download screen (interactive, with a change of quotes);
- Optimization of the first scene by 25-30%;
- The scenes after the dream are optimized by 15-20%;
- Ability to skip the first scene (we know you've been waiting for this);
- Visual changes in the scene in front of the house (steam from the mouth, it’s snowing, traces on the snow);
- New scene/location (on the level with the corridor);
- We changed the scene behind the house (in front of the basement);
- Sound design (the scene with the father);
- Sound signals in the basement, with the right choice and wrong (also when dropping the right choices);
- Boarded up elevator doors on the 2nd-3rd floor (so you understand what to do);
- Captions (a small scene in 3 minutes, before downloading the menu);
- Fountain in the toilet at its descent (the most important change, of course).

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Dear players!

We've fixed some more bugs in the game:

- Capacity improved (5-15%)
- Three final scenes changed (actions, animations)
- A cat in the kitchen added
- ES logo added
- Bugs with collisions removed
- Tips in every scene added
- Heroes' shaking in several scenes removed  

Thanks for your feedback and support. We do our best to make Typical Nightmare better.

tags.feature: - A cat in the kitchen added

tags.bug: - Bugs with collisions removed
- Heroes' shaking in several scenes removed

notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.content:
Dear players!

We fixed several bugs that spoiled your experience with Typical Nightmare:

- Subtitles fixed (they doubled and changes size)
- Jam in textures fixed
- Tips for players added
- Saving bug removed
- Sounds fixed
- Optimization partly completed
- Game weight 60% reduced
- Loading time reduced
- Several visual bugs removed
- Lift bugs fixed

Currently, we're working hard to optimize the rest of the game. We appreciate your words of support in comments and thank you for your feedback and warm response. We do our best to fix the game and improve your experience with Typical Nightmare. 

We apologize for any inconveniences.
